transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Tell me about a time you saw a problem that wasn't yours to fix, and you fixed it anyway.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: Our engineering onboarding checklist hadn't been touched in 18 months. I catalogued every broken link, rewrote the document with tested instructions, added a 'last verified' date block, and set up a monthly reminder. Onboarding time dropped from a day to four hours based on feedback forms.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate on a technical decision.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: The backend lead and I disagreed about API versioning. He thought it was premature. I proposed we measure the cost of retrofitting in three similar systems. The data showed two of three had significant rework. We designed a lightweight scheme. He cited it as a model for breaking architecture deadlocks.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Tell me about a time you were wrong about something technical.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: I was an enthusiastic advocate for event-driven architecture before we had enough complexity. My team spent a sprint building a Kafka pipeline that a polling job would have solved in two days. I wrote a learning doc and added a decision checklist. Three subsequent proposals were simplified.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: What's a weakness you've had to actively work on?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: I under-communicate when I'm uncertain. I go quiet in planning meetings. My manager flagged this. I started being explicit about confidence levels. My skip-level asked where I'd learned that framing.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Tell me about a time you had to push back on a direction you disagreed with.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: Legal wanted all AI-generated content flagged with a disclosure that would crater engagement. I got competitor data, presented it alongside legal risk, and we co-designed a sufficient but less intrusive disclosure. We measured no engagement impact post-launch.
